game_title: Type Sorter – Crater Lake Edge Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling cooling flasks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Sort falling cooling flasks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, lava imps strike the smelter, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the smelter from lava imps in Crater Lake Edge: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while sorted_ok > 0.
